description: A compound assignment, `++`, `--` and the logical assignments read and write, so each consults join(get, set): a throwing getter is reported through the read half and a throwing setter through the write half.

diagnostics.message: Updating `throwingGet.value` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.

Updating `throwingSet.value` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the setter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the setter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
